verdict.rationale: The skill writes its deliverables as open-format files: production-ready SVGs, PNG renders, and a favicon/app-icon/web-manifest set. It is itself packaged in the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md) that works in any agent supporting skills, so there is little lock-in and leaving is easy. Portability of all data is implied by these local outputs rather than documented as an explicit export feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that every artifact (briefs, concepts, brand guidelines) is saved as local open-format files, the file format of the brand guidelines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
